What it is: Per-role lifecycle: actually park the roles a ticket does not need, and bring them back when it does (routing epic slice 3)
What it solves: WHY IT IS ITS OWN TICKET. The dynamic-per-ticket-agent-routing epic has four slices:
(1) auto-hibernate on drain — BL-307 shipped, but BL-318 says it can never fire;
(2) routing manifest `roles:` field — BL-317, active; (3) per-role lifecycle — THIS,
previously not ticketed at all, existing only as…
How it works: A ticket's manifest shapes the swarm to exactly the roles it needs
